image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured brown surface. The bib is primarily orange with a raised, bubble-like texture (minky dot fabric). It features a secondary flap or pocket made of orange and white striped fabric. There are decorative elements resembling dark brown leaves or seeds attached to the front. The neck opening is visible at the top left, trimmed with white piping.

To verify the structural integrity of the layered pocket/flap and ensure no fusion artifacts between the stripes and the main orange body.
To analyze the consistency of the raised 'bubble' texture and check for AI-generated smearing or unnatural repetition in the pattern.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the striped pocket and the orange body. AI often struggles with stitching lines or layer boundaries on textiles. Also, verify if the 'bubble' texture deforms logically around the edges or if it looks pasted on.
